titlePl: Ósmoklasista: Sport — 36 haseł do gier LingoSpark
titleEn: Grade 8 English: Sport — 36 terms for LingoSpark games
blurbPl: Dział Sport: dyscypliny, sprzęt, mecz, kibice. Wklejasz do Bomb Defusal, fiszek i Live Quiz.
blurbEn: Grade-8 Sport module: sports, equipment, matches, fans. Paste into Bomb, Flashcards and Live Quiz.

items.definitionEn: to take part in a race or contest and try to win
items.example: Ten schools will compete in the swimming gala.

items.definitionEn: the person or team you play against
items.example: Our opponent in the final is last year's winner.

items.definitionEn: the official who controls a football or rugby match
items.example: The referee blew the whistle for half-time.

items.definitionEn: the official who controls tennis or volleyball
items.example: The umpire said the ball was out.

items.definitionEn: a large building with seats around a sports field
items.example: The sports stadium was full of excited fans.

items.definitionEn: the grass area where football or rugby is played
items.example: The pitch was too wet, so the match was cancelled.

items.definitionEn: the marked area for tennis, basketball or volleyball
items.example: We booked a tennis court for four o'clock.

items.definitionEn: the path used for running races
items.example: Athletes run 400 metres around the track.

items.definitionEn: the player who stops the ball going into the goal
items.example: The goalkeeper saved the penalty.

items.definitionEn: to get a goal or point; the number of points
items.example: We need to score one more goal to win.

items.definitionEn: a result where both sides have the same score
items.example: The match ended in a draw, two–two.

items.definitionEn: a loss; to win against someone
items.example: A 6–0 defeat was hard to accept.

items.definitionEn: the fact of winning
items.example: The team celebrated their first victory of the season.

items.definitionEn: a competition to decide the best team or player
items.example: She won the school tennis championship.

items.definitionEn: a series of games until there is a winner
items.example: The basketball tournament lasts all weekend.

items.definitionEn: a person who is trained for sport, especially running or jumping
items.example: The athlete broke the school record in the long jump.

items.definitionEn: a person who trains a team or player
items.example: Our coach makes us stretch before every session.

items.definitionEn: regular practice to get better at a sport
items.example: Football training is on Wednesdays at five.

items.definitionEn: gentle exercise before a hard session
items.example: Never skip the warm-up or you may get injured.

items.definitionEn: damage to your body from sport or an accident
items.example: He missed the final because of a knee injury.

items.definitionEn: a person who watches a sports event
items.example: Spectators must stay behind the fence.

items.definitionEn: a person who regularly follows a team
items.example: The supporters sang during the whole match.

items.definitionEn: to start doing a sport or hobby regularly
items.example: She wants to take up volleyball next term.

items.definitionEn: to stop doing something you used to do
items.example: Do not give up swimming after one hard lesson.

items.definitionEn: to stay healthy through exercise
items.example: He jogs three times a week to keep fit.

items.definitionEn: a sport you do alone, not in a team
items.example: Tennis is an individual sport, but you can also play doubles.

items.definitionEn: a sport played by groups against each other
items.example: Football is the most popular team sport at our school.

items.definitionEn: sports with a high level of danger, such as climbing
items.example: He loves extreme sports such as snowboarding.

items.definitionEn: sports such as karate or judo
items.example: She goes to martial arts classes on Mondays.

items.definitionEn: exercises on the floor or apparatus that need strength and control
items.example: Gymnastics requires a lot of practice and balance.

items.definitionEn: sports that include running, jumping and throwing
items.example: Sports day includes athletics events such as the 100 metres.

items.definitionEn: a place with water for swimming
items.example: The swimming pool opens at seven in the morning.

items.definitionEn: a room where you change clothes before sport
items.example: Leave your bag in the changing room.

items.definitionEn: a cup or object given to the winner
items.example: The winning team lifted the trophy.

items.definitionEn: a metal disc given for first, second or third place
items.example: She won a gold medal in the 200 metres.

items.definitionEn: to do better than the best result so far
items.example: He hopes to break a record in the long jump.
